note: Negative precedents — requests this authority has declined, with the reason and the routes to try instead. Maintained via adjudication (2026-10-07) and reviewer verdicts. Kernel-generic: any authority may carry this file.

precedents.title: Chart treatments
precedents.request: bar chart / heatmap / sparkline / data visualisation
precedents.reason: No chart treatment exists anywhere in the wink evidence; the canon must not invent chart grammar.
try: Compose a minimal data block from existing primitives (display numerals, rules, spacing) and mark it as an improvisation.
If charts genuinely recur across consumers, file a proposal citing at least two live-product instances.

precedents.title: Photographic avatars & icon glyphs
precedents.reason: Asset policy: illustration/photography are not reproduced (no asset library); no glyph-style evidence exists.
try: Use a monogram/textual avatar rendered in the canon type system.
Prefer words and existing marks over invented glyphs; small marks compose from the type system.

precedents.title: Neutral tag variant
precedents.reason: No tag/chip evidence; component/badge claims 'tag' for the emphasis case only; a neutral variant is a marked consumer composition (borderline — see adjudication notes).
try: For neutral labels, compose plain text + spacing in the parsnip/ink palette and mark it; a future proposal needs live-product evidence.

precedents.title: Native form controls (toggle, checkbox, radio)
precedents.reason: fallback/platform-controls already scopes all three (resolve returns FALLBACK); platform defaults are the sanctioned answer.
try: Use the platform-controls fallback with field-level styling and mark it as a fallback.
Do not style native controls beyond the field language.

precedents.title: Pagination & drag-to-reorder
precedents.reason: No evidence; the pager composes (outline pill + readout) and drag is unevidenced interaction behaviour.
try: Compose the pager from an outline pill action plus a plain readout.
For reordering, prefer explicit move actions or leave the interaction unstyled and marked; report if it recurs.

precedents.title: CSV export affordance
precedents.reason: No evidence; the affordance composes from component/action-pill; the download flow is utility behaviour, not interface canon.
try: Use an action pill (or small outline pill) labelled with the concrete verb.
Treat the surrounding file flow as app utility, outside canon.

precedents.title: Dark mode
precedents.reason: fallback/light-only is the sanctioned answer; dark mode is a deliberately carried UNDEFINED in the source gestalt.
try: Use the light-only fallback and mark it.
Keep colour roles (not hexes) in any adaptation so a future dark canon could slot in.

precedents.title: Status pill (proposal rejected at review)
precedents.request: component/status-pill — four-tone word-first status pill (neutral Parsnip, attention Ochre, positive ink-only, problem #BF4055)
precedents.reason: Adjudicated proposal for a four-tone word-first status pill; rejected at gate review (no reviewer note recorded). The evidence route remains short of live-product confirmation for the four tones.
try: Express status with words plus component/badge where emphasis is needed.
Compose state colour from token-set/colour tints only if a real need presses, and mark the composition.
Re-propose only with live-product evidence for the tone set.
